setting: An island about two kilometres across, with a mountain range along it, rivers to the sea and a few lakes. A walled town stands in the lowland, villages lie near water, giants live on a high shelf in the hills and small folk in a forest hollow. A terraced hill town of brick and iron stands above a river, and a harbour town of concrete and neon by the sea. Roads join them.

towns.name: Brackenford
towns.character: the island's market town, walled, busy and proud of its square
towns.ledger: Brackenford. The gates are kept by the town. The market is for anyone who comes in peace.

towns.name: Highshelf
towns.character: the giants' settlement on its high shelf; slow-spoken, patient people who build in stone

towns.name: Fernhollow
towns.character: the small folk's hollow in the forest; quick, curious and fond of gardens

towns.name: Kettlebridge
towns.character: a hill town of brick and iron on terraces above a river; works and foundries, a clock tower in the square

towns.name: Lanternquay
towns.character: a dense harbour town of concrete blocks, neon and street stalls, busy at all hours

villages.name: Elmwick
villages.character: a farming village by the water

villages.name: Thornby
villages.character: a village of fishers and hunters

villages.name: Reedmoor
villages.character: a small village at the edge of the reeds

packs.name: the wolves of the town road
